backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Backed up once a day, keeping the last 14, on this computer (on the same disk as the library). If this computer breaks or is lost, the sync server or a copy kept elsewhere brings your notes back.
backup.confirmAll: Every card and journal day goes back to how it was on {{date}}: anything written after that, in any card, leaves the library (what is there now is first saved as a “before restore” backup). Only needed when the library is damaged.

copy.title: Keep a copy elsewhere
copy.hint: After each backup, the backups and every image and attachment are copied to a cloud drive, an external drive or a NAS too, so a failed disk here loses nothing.
copy.stopped: Stopped copying; the backups already there stay
copy.done: Last copied {{when}} · {{backups}} backups, {{files}} images and attachments, {{size}} in all
copy.unavailable: This location cannot be found right now (is the drive plugged in?). What it missed is copied within an hour of it coming back.
copy.foreign: This folder holds another library's backups: you can restore from them, but nothing is copied into it, so two libraries' backups never mix.
copy.skipped_one: {{count}} image or attachment could not be read or is damaged, so it was not copied; it is tried again next time.
copy.skipped_other: {{count}} images or attachments could not be read or are damaged, so they were not copied; they are tried again next time.
copy.sameDisk: This location is on the same disk as the library: if the disk fails, both copies are lost. A USB drive, another disk or a cloud drive folder is safer.
copy.pickNew: The backups and all images and attachments will be copied into a new “Folio Backup” folder in “{{path}}”. New content is added after every backup; nothing else in the folder is touched.
copy.pickOurs: “{{path}}” already holds this library's backups; copying goes on there.
copy.pickOther: “{{path}}” holds another library's backups (say, from before a new computer). Choose “Elsewhere” in the backup list below to restore the whole library from them; copying then goes on there.
copy.confirmFiles: The backup's images and attachments come back too.
copy.encryptYesHint: Encrypted with a passphrase: whoever gets these files sees neither your notes nor the file names. This computer remembers the key, so copying needs no typing; restoring on another computer asks for the passphrase.
copy.encryptNoHint: Not encrypted: the backups are plain files that anyone who can open this drive can read.
copy.encryptNoCloud: Not encrypted: the cloud provider and anyone who can sign in to this account can read your notes.
copy.forgotten: Keep this passphrase safe: without it this copy cannot be restored, and Folio cannot help.
copy.enterPassphrase: The backups here are encrypted: enter the passphrase they were made with.
copy.locked: This copy is encrypted and this computer does not have its key: enter the passphrase to keep copying.
copy.mode: The backups in this folder are not encrypted the way the settings say; copying has stopped. Choose this place again.

offsite.title: Copies off this computer
offsite.sync: The sync server holds the whole library as it is now, images and attachments included, end-to-end encrypted · Last synced: {{when}}
offsite.syncNever: Sync is on but has not succeeded yet: the server does not have a full copy.
offsite.syncFailing: Sync is failing: the copy on the server may be out of date. Check the sync settings.
offsite.syncPending: Some changes or files are not up yet; they go up once you are online.
offsite.syncNote: Sync keeps only the latest version: to undo a deletion or a bad edit, restore a backup below.
offsite.none: Your notes are only on this computer: if its disk fails or it is lost, they are gone. Turn on sync, or keep a copy elsewhere below.

mcp.approvalTitle: Let an AI tool read your notes?

sync.title: Sync
sync.description: Sync notes between your devices through a server you run yourself. Notes are encrypted on this device before they leave it; the server sees neither content nor which card is which.
sync.createHint: First device: enter the server address and its token (the FOLIO_SERVER_TOKEN folio-server was started with), then choose a passphrase.
sync.joinHint: Other devices: paste the sync code shown on the first device and enter the same passphrase.
sync.passphraseShort: The passphrase needs at least {{n}} characters
sync.passphraseWarning: The passphrase encrypts your notes and stays on your devices. Forget it and new devices can join only with a recovery code, which you can make here once sync is on.
sync.errorNetwork: cannot reach the server. Check its address and that it is running.
sync.errorPassphrase: the passphrase does not open this sync space.
sync.errorCode: this is not a sync code. Copy it whole from the first device.
sync.errorNoWorkspace: the server has no such sync space.
sync.errorRemoved: another device removed this one from the sync space. To go on, stop syncing here and join again.
sync.errorKeyMissing: This device cannot read its sync key from the system's secure storage (keychain) (the library may have been copied or restored from another device). Your notes are all here. To go on, stop syncing here and join again with the sync code.
sync.codeHint: The code holds the server address and token, not the passphrase. Share it only with your own devices.
sync.stopConfirm: Notes here stay, the server keeps its data, other devices are not affected.
sync.devicesHint: Every device that has synced with this space.
sync.stale: Not synced for over {{days}} days. If it is no longer used, remove it.
sync.removeConfirm: It will no longer sync. To use it again, stop syncing on it and join again: its notes merge back. The passphrase and key stay the same.
sync.errorFileTooLarge: A file is larger than the server allows
sync.errorServerFull: The server is out of room for files
sync.forgotPassphrase: Forgot the passphrase? Join with a recovery code
sync.recoverHint: Forgot the passphrase: paste the sync code and the recovery code, then set a new passphrase. Devices that join later use the new one.
sync.recoverNote: Devices already syncing are not affected and don't need the new passphrase.
sync.recoveryHint: If you forget the passphrase, the sync code and the recovery code let a new device join and set a new passphrase. The server keeps only the key encrypted with the recovery code, never the code itself.
sync.recoveryReplaceConfirm: The old recovery code stops working right away.
sync.recoveryShownOnce: The recovery code is shown only this once. Keep it somewhere safe with the sync code (a password manager, say): anyone with both can read your notes.
sync.changePassphraseHint: Devices that join from now on use the new passphrase. Devices already syncing are not affected, and nothing is re-encrypted.
sync.errorRecoveryFormat: That is not a valid recovery code. It has 8 groups of 4 characters.
sync.errorRecoveryWrong: Wrong recovery code; it doesn't open this sync space.
sync.errorNoRecovery: This sync space has no recovery code yet.
sync.errorOldServer: The server is too old for this. Upgrade folio-server first.
sync.recoveryMissing: No recovery code yet. If you forget the passphrase and no device is still syncing, no new device can join. Make one now.

libraryPlace.backToDefault: Move back to the default place
libraryPlace.confirmMove: Move the library to {{path}}? It is copied in full and checked file by file before Folio switches to it. The original folder is kept under a new name (ending in .moved-…); delete it yourself once the new place works.
libraryPlace.confirmDefault: Move the library back to the default place, {{path}}? Like any move, it is copied and checked first and the original folder is kept.
libraryPlace.confirmOpen: Open the library in {{path}}? The current library stays where it is; you can open it again any time.
libraryPlace.confirmNew: Start a new, empty library in {{path}}? The current library stays where it is; you can open it again any time.
libraryPlace.cloudWarning: This place is synced by a cloud drive such as iCloud or Dropbox. The drive may copy the database while it is written and damage it, and two computers opening the same library overwrite each other. Use Folio's own sync for several devices.
libraryPlace.cloudNow: The library is in a folder synced by a cloud drive. Move it to a local folder and use Folio's sync for several devices.
libraryPlace.missing: The library you chose, {{path}}, was not found (an external disk not connected?), so the default library is open. Connect it and restart Folio.
libraryPlace.fixed: Set by the FOLIO_DATA_DIR environment variable; it cannot be changed here.

problem.intoItself: A library cannot be moved into its own folder.
problem.occupied: There is already a library in {{path}}. To use it, choose “Open another library”.
problem.notEmpty: The Folio folder in {{path}} is not empty; choose another place.
problem.current: This is the library that is open.
problem.other: This folder has other files in it and is not a Folio library. To start a new library, choose an empty folder.
